intent: Teach the pacman-wrapper installer to deploy install_leechblock.sh's lib/ directory alongside the entry script, so the deployed copy at /usr/local/share/digital_wellbeing/ can actually run after the split.
scope: Non-goal: any change to install_leechblock.sh or its libs -- they shipped in 1dceca66 and are untouched here
changes: install_leechblock_payload now mirrors the four leechblock_*.sh libs into ${LEECHBLOCK_INSTALL_DIR}/lib and marks them executable. Before this, the deployer copied the entry script and three data files but no lib/, so after the split the deployed installer would die on its first `source`.
The copy is a mirror (rm -rf then recreate), not a merge, so a lib removed upstream does not linger in the deployed tree.
The glob is leechblock_*.sh, not *.sh, on purpose: lib/ is shared with unrelated music_detect.sh / music_monitor.sh / music_status.sh helpers that this payload has no business shipping to /usr/local.
A missing lib/ now emits an explicit warning that the deployed installer will not run, rather than silently deploying a broken entry script.

verification.command: install_leechblock_payload against a fake root (/tmp/fakeroot) with the real sources
verification.evidence: Deployed tree contains exactly install_leechblock.sh, leechblock_defaults.json, seed_leechblock_storage.js and lib/{browsers,config,fetch,firefox}.sh -- the four leechblock libs and none of the three music_* helpers.
Exit 0 with the normal usage text, proving the deployed entry script resolves its libs from the deployed lib/ rather than dying on `source`.

verification.command: inject_default_config in the deployed layout with a node stub
verification.evidence: DEFAULTS_SRC and the seeder resolved to /tmp/fakeroot/digital_wellbeing/*, not to lib/. This is the specific silent failure the SCRIPT_DIR fix in 1dceca66 targets, now confirmed in the deployed layout as well as the repo tree.

verification.command: Real deploy to /usr/local/share/digital_wellbeing/ + bash <deployed> --help + sha256sum comparison
verification.evidence: Live deployed copy runs (exit 0, usage text) and its sha256 is identical to the repo's install_leechblock.sh. The deployed lib/ holds the four libs, executable.

verification.command: shellcheck + shfmt idempotence + bash -n on both changed files
verification.evidence: shellcheck rc=0, shfmt -w is a no-op on both, both parse. 70 and 130 lines, under the 250-line cap.

risks: This commit closes a window that the split itself opened: between 1dceca66 and this change, running the deployer would have overwritten a working deployed copy with a split entry script and no libs. The live copy was repaired by hand during this session and is now deployed correctly from the fixed path.
The deployer is reached via /etc/pacman.d/hooks/96-restore-pkg-wrappers.hook -> rewrap_pkg_managers.sh on pacman/pacman-git transactions, so the window was real but narrow.
npm install --prefix still runs against LEECHBLOCK_INSTALL_DIR when package.json is present; unchanged by this commit.
rollback: git revert this commit; install_leechblock_payload returns to copying the entry script without lib/.
After rollback the deployed installer would break again on its next deploy, so also either revert 1dceca66 or hand-restore the pre-split entry script to /usr/local/share/digital_wellbeing/.
